01 / About

Research at the boundary of meaning and security.

KALI—Knowledge, Adversaries, Language & Intelligence—is led by Dr. Mithun Paul Saint-Germain. We develop practical and principled approaches to secure AI agents, language technology, and emerging computational paradigms. We care about agents that work beyond the benchmark: under distribution shift, adversarial pressure, untrusted tool outputs, and real-world access constraints.

02 / Research

Three connected directions

We build AI agents that are
capable, legible, and resilient.

R / 01

Language & reasoning

Language understanding and reasoning for agents: fact verification, causal models, and data-efficient transfer across domains.

  • Agent reasoning
  • Fact verification
  • Knowledge distillation
R / 02

AI agent security

Securing tool-using agents against indirect prompt injection: identifying where an attack enters, which actions it corrupts, whether the agent resisted, and how its behavior drifted.

  • Trajectory security
  • Attack localization
  • Behavioral drift
  • Prompt injection
R / 03

Quantum language

Scalable quantum natural language processing, compositional models, and multilingual grammar-aware foundations for future intelligent agents.

  • Agent language
  • QNLP
  • Pregroup grammar
  • Multilingual systems
